conceptual.description: Symmetric catch-all link retained for backward compatibility. v2 retyping (2026-04-21) replaced all in-use `conceptual` edges with specific predicates (studies, inspires, subjectOf, involves). New data should prefer a specific predicate.

contains.description: Subject is a structural parent of the object — hub → child node, cluster → member, installation → exhibited component.

contributesTo.description: Subject (artists, witnesses, collaborators) supply material or attention to the object (a training corpus or shared artifact).

in-cluster.description: Runtime membership — a visitor dream or cluster-summary sits in a k-means cluster of semantically-similar prompts. Added dynamically as prompts arrive.

inspires.description: Subject (typically the Salish Sea ecosystem) is the imaginative or generative source for the object (visitor dreams, the dreaming machine's outputs).

involves.description: Subject (an installation or project) integrates or touches the object (a subsystem). Radial predicate from install:salish-sea-dreaming outward to each subsystem hub.

sampledBy.description: Subject (an ecosystem or population) is sampled by the object (a training corpus). Fixes v1's backwards ssd:training direction.

signal.description: Subject sends a runtime signal or data stream to the object — OSC, SSE, MIDI control, or similar inter-process channel.

studies.description: Subject (knowledge, research, reports) investigates or documents the object (a subject matter, usually an ecosystem or concept).

subjectOf.description: Subject is the thing depicted or featured; object is the work that depicts it (ecosystem → exhibition, ecosystem → report).

training.description: Deprecated catch-all used in v1 for training-corpus edges regardless of direction. v2 retyping (2026-04-21) split it into ssd:sampledBy, ssd:contributesTo, and ssd:trains with correct direction.

training-lora.description: Subject supplies LoRA fine-tuning data to the object. A narrower specialisation of ssd:trains used for style-transfer LoRAs (e.g., Briony watercolors).

trains.description: Subject (training corpus, dataset) supplies training data that teaches the object (model, dreaming machine).

visitor-signal.description: A visitor-originated signal path — typically the prompt pipeline from the browser interface to the live visual system.
